title: Modular properties of affine \(\SLA{sl}{2}\) torus \(n\)-point functions
summary: Krauel, Shafiq and Wood (\KSW{}) realized torus \(1\)-point functions for the simple affine \voa{}s \(L(k,0)\) built from \(\alg{sl}(2)\) as vector-valued modular forms attached to a cyclic \(R\)-module structure and to the modular tensor category \(\rep{L(k,0)}\). We extend this to torus \(n\)-point functions, defined as traces of chains of \(n\) intertwining operators winding once around the \(τ\)-cycle.
